title: Chapter 37 The Journey Of Two People And One Dragon
content:
Chapter 37 The Journey Of Two People And One Dragon

Tianxuan World, in the deserted city.

"Tianyin, I feel like something big is going to happen recently."

On the top floor of Baihua Tower.

The wealthy Ji Shengcai hugged Mu Tianyin and said with a serious look.

Seeing Ji Shengcai like this, Mu Tianyin also became cautious.

She hadn't seen Ji Shengcai like this for a long time.

"What happened?"

Mu Tianyin asked hurriedly.

Hearing this, Ji Shengcai said: "Many people in the city lord's mansion have lost contact, and didn't you notice that the guards in the city have become very few, only a few people."

Hearing this, Mu Tianyin was stunned and suddenly became nervous.

"What do you think happened?"

Ji Shengcai looked up and looked out the window. "There must be another war in the Wasteland City, and this war may not even be sure of the Wasteland City, so the city lord's mansion is so urgent."

"This, this is impossible."

Mu Tianyin couldn't believe it. Living in the Wasteland City for a long time has given her a feeling that the Wasteland City is invincible in the world.

Not only her, but everyone living in the city has this idea.

Ji Shengcai shook his head and didn't say anything about it. Instead, he said: "Tianyin, has your master come out of retreat?"

Hearing this, Mu Tianyin said helplessly: "No, he said that he will not come out of retreat until he is invincible."

"What?"

Ji Shengcai was dumbfounded.

Then he might as well retreat for the rest of his life.

Mu Tianyin's master, one of the few Heavenly Emperors in the Xuan Gu Galaxy.

Of course, that was in the past.

At that time, Mu Tianyin had a Heavenly Emperor behind him. In the Tianxuan world where there was no Heavenly Emperor, you can imagine how terrifying it was.

This is also the reason why Ji Wuhui was afraid of Mu Tianyin's background.

Unfortunately, the times have changed.

Mu Tianyin's master came to the Tianxuan world, especially in the deserted city, where there were so many masters.

He became inconspicuous in an instant.

So not long after arriving in the deserted city, Mu Tianyin's master went into seclusion, and has been in seclusion until now.

......

In the city lord's mansion.

"Jiang Lao, where is my father?"

Lu Xue wandered around in the city lord's mansion, but there was no one except the guards that could be seen everywhere in the city lord's mansion.

This made Lu Xue a little confused.

Where are the people?

Seeing Lu Xue, Jiang Yuan hurriedly bowed respectfully.

"This old servant greets the young lady. Young lady, the city lord is busy with all kinds of things. Maybe he went to do something very important."

"Do you mean that my father went out again?"

Jiang Yuan smiled bitterly and did not answer.

Seeing this, Lu Xue waved her hand, "Okay, okay, I got it."

Then, Jiang Yuan retreated.

"My father is out, and they are all busy in the City Lord's Mansion, so I am the only one left?"

Lu Xue sorted it out and smiled immediately.

"Then I can do whatever I want?"

Hehehe.

Soon, Lu Xue returned to her residence to prepare, and went to Lu Daosheng's residence to leave a letter, and then came out.

"Xiao Qing!"

A call, the next moment, Ao Qing appeared in front of Lu Xue.

"Master, what do you want?"

"Nothing, I'm going out, you follow me."

"Master, where are you going?"

Hearing this, Lu Xue was stunned.

Now, she has reached the realm of the ancient realm.

Although she likes to play at ordinary times, she is more serious than anyone else when practicing.

But now, she seems to have never been anywhere except the Wasteland City.

She has never even been out of the Wasteland State, let alone the outside world.

"Wow, I don't know where to go. I'm so miserable."

"No, it's all my dad's fault. He never lets me go out, saying it's too dangerous outside. Now I'm going out like a fool."

At this time, Ao Qing said, "Master, this is easy. We can just pick a direction and keep going."

Hearing this, Lu Xue's face lit up, and then she patted Ao Qing.

"Not bad, not bad. I didn't expect that you look silly, but you are actually quite smart."

Ao Qing said in his heart: Master, it's you who looks silly.

"Well, why do I feel like you are secretly scolding me."

"Master, the world can witness it. How dare I insult you."

Soon, Ao Qing transformed into his original form and turned into a giant dragon.

Lu Xue was not polite and rode on it directly.

Instantly, one person and one dragon flew into the sky and came to the starry sky of Tianxuan World.

Just when the two of them were about to take action, a red figure appeared in front of them, blocking their way.

"Xiaoxue, where are you going?"

Ouyang Yanqing looked at Lu Xue and Ao Qing with a frown.

At the beginning, Lu Daosheng told her to protect Lu Xue and it would be best if she stayed with him all the time.

She couldn't let Lu Xue leave her perception range.

"Sister Ouyang, I, I just want to go out for a walk."

Seeing Ouyang Yanqing, Lu Xue felt a little guilty for some reason.

Hearing this, Ouyang Yanqing immediately said, "No, your father asked me to protect you well. What if I get into danger when I go out?"

"Then, then you can follow me. My father didn't say that I can't go out."

"This,"

Hearing Lu Xue's words, Ouyang Yanqing was a little speechless.

What she said seemed to make sense.

At this time, Lu Xue ran directly to Ouyang Yanqing, pulled Ouyang Yanqing's arm and started to act coquettishly.

"Sister Ouyang, please go out with me. I have never been out of the house since I was a child."

"Besides, Sister Ouyang, you are so strong. How could there be any danger around you?"

Suddenly, Ouyang Yanqing's mouth corners unconsciously rose slightly.

"Well, then, okay, but you can't leave my side, understand?"

Seeing Ouyang Yanqing agreed, Lu Xue immediately showed a touching smile.

"Okay, okay, Sister Ouyang is the best!"

Then, the team of one person and one dragon became two people and one dragon.

In addition, Ouyang Yanqing is knowledgeable, and the team is no longer like a headless fly.

Soon, under Ao Qing's speed, the three of them quickly left the range of Xuan Gu Galaxy.

"Wuhu! Faster and faster!!"

On Ao Qing's back, Lu Xue felt the speed and passion and shouted excitedly.

Hearing this, Ao Qing's speed also suddenly accelerated a few points.

"My dear, you are steady!"

Boom!

The speed was so fast that it left space scratches everywhere it passed, which could not be restored for a long time.

"Xiaoxue, if your father knew, would he be angry?"

Beside Lu Xue, Ouyang Yanqing was not as obsessed as the two of them, but looked a little worried.

Hearing this, Lu Xue was stunned.

"Uh, it should be, maybe, probably, it will be."

At this time, Lu Xue could even imagine Lu Daosheng lecturing her with a stern face.

Thinking of that scene, Lu Xue suddenly felt uncomfortable.

"Oh, it's okay, at most I will be scolded, my father will not do anything to me, he has only one precious daughter."

This is the pride of an only child.

What's more, Lu Daosheng is a complete daughter slave.

Seeing this, Ouyang Yanqing sighed and said nothing.

And at this moment, a roar suddenly sounded.

"How dare you! Who gave you the courage to be so reckless in the Tianmang Galaxy?!"

The next moment, a figure full of ancient aura stood in front of Ao Qing.

However, facing this figure, Ao Qing did not even look at him.

With a bang.

The figure was knocked away.

"Huh? What was that just now?"

Lu Xue looked at the bright galaxy in confusion and touched her head.

"It's okay, my lady. It should have been a fly just now."

"Oh, okay."

Ouyang Yanqing on the side helplessly held his forehead.

One is fearless, the other is ignorant. Fortunately, he followed me, otherwise he would not know what kind of trouble he would make.
